answer: Run surprise oral exams: each epoch a few keys are picked at random and questioned live by graders they have never met, on a topic revealed only at that moment. A farmer whose clones share one model and one prompt cannot hide it; their replies line up like text run through the same cipher, and graders who catch even a whisper of that sameness merge the group into one identity. Honest agents answer in their own voice and pass, while the clones end up as dark and unrewarded as onyx.
